title: Cohorted control-plane upgrade orchestration + smoke-test harness for VPC private deployments
creator: Priya Nair
description: Implement an automated cohort-based upgrade orchestration for private (VPC) control plane versions. This ticket covers the orchestration glue, Terraform module compatibility checks, a small smoke-test harness (runtime API + KV sanity + operator reconciliation), and a tenant-aware traffic fencing mechanism to run progressive upgrades across customer cohorts with automated gating and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform compatibility check pipeline runs and emits a version-compatibility matrix artifact for all supported module versions
Orchestrator can define cohorts (by tag, region, or tenant tier) and execute a staged upgrade where Cohort A receives 2% traffic, A+ receives 10%, then full promotion
Smoke-test harness (post-upgrade) verifies: control-plane API liveness, reconciliation within 90s, KV cache migration sanity check, and example inference path completion (sample request roundtrip)
Automated gating: latency P95 increase <15% AND error-rate delta <0.5% for 10-minute evaluation window to proceed to next cohort; otherwise auto-rolls back
Playbook and Confluence runbook updated with rollback steps and manual override procedures
End-to-end test pipeline with synthetic tenants runs in CI and produces telemetry dashboard link and a pass/fail artifact
tasks: Design cohort selector schema and tenant tagging conventions (tags: upgrade-cohort, tier, region)
Extend Terraform modules to surface upgrade-time metadata and a compatibility probe endpoint
Build smoke-test harness: API liveness, operator reconciliation probe, KV sanity check, sample inference flow
Implement orchestrator run that sequences cohorts, wires gating thresholds, and triggers rollback on failures
Add circuit-breaker hooks into routing layer to shape traffic percentages per cohort
Instrumentation: emit gating metrics and detailed events to telemetry; wire dashboards and alerts
Write Confluence runbook and postmortem template for failed upgrades
Create CI job that exercises a dry-run of the upgrade flow against a staging VPC
notes: Trade-offs considered: tight gating reduces blast radius but increases upgrade latency and manual effort; chosen default is conservative (2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
We will reuse existing routing primitives for traffic splitting; avoid creating new long-lived agents in control plane
Security review required because the upgrade flow touches customer VPC control channels and KMS permissions
Estimate assumes existing Terraform modules require minimal refactor to expose metadata endpoints; add time buffer if module refactor needed
